description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/sedimentation_upwind1_flux_D_lev driven by problems/sedimentation_column_upwind_forced.esm (layer-centred downward velocity W = -(1 + z), matching forcing). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution exp(-t) sin(pi z) is exact for the continuous PDE; the recorded L2 errors at t=0.1 are the donor-cell spatial error and are expected to fall as O(dz) (first order).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
